baselineStatement: The stub-backed UI at /platform/stub completed a facilitated design and navigation spot-testing pass after in-session remediation of the route layout, skip-link routing, stub query-page rendering, and report-navigation exposure defects. No open in-scope defects remained at closeout.

checklistExecution.title: Stub route loads the hosted shell review surface
checklistExecution.notes: The route initially rendered inside the main shell, then passed after the stub page moved to a standalone layout.

checklistExecution.title: Skip link reaches the main workspace cleanly
checklistExecution.notes: Activating the skip link now stays on /platform/stub#dabbler-main-content instead of escaping to the app root.

checklistExecution.title: Primary navigation and workspace tabs keep an obvious focus path
checklistExecution.notes: The facilitated pass observed a visible skip-link focus state and stable workspace tab transitions; no additional focus-path defect was confirmed.

checklistExecution.title: Customer search page layout is understandable before searching
checklistExecution.notes: The hosted stub customer page rendered with labeled Name and City filters plus a visible Search action after the query-page crash was fixed.

checklistExecution.title: Customer search results render through the hosted stub path
checklistExecution.notes: The stub grid rendered three customer rows without error once the PropertyColumn bindings were corrected.

checklistExecution.title: Recent-customer navigation opens a detail tab in the workspace
checklistExecution.notes: Selecting Ada Lovelace opened a detail tab alongside the search tab in the same workspace.

checklistExecution.title: Report navigation opens the stub customer summary report
checklistExecution.notes: The report entry became reachable after report items were surfaced in the shared navigation panel.

checklistExecution.title: Workspace tab switching stays understandable across search, detail, and report pages
checklistExecution.notes: The facilitated pass observed distinct Customers Search, Customer: 101, and CustomerSummary tabs in a shared workspace.

checklistExecution.title: Report toolbar remains keyboard reachable after the report loads
checklistExecution.notes: The facilitated report pass showed the toolbar after load and did not surface a contrary hosted-browser defect; related semantics remain covered by existing report tests.

checklistExecution.title: Rendered report content stays readable and visually ordered
checklistExecution.notes: The rendered Stub Customer Summary report stayed legible in the hosted shell after report navigation was exposed.

confirmedIssues.title: Stub route rendered inside the main application shell instead of the standalone stub host
reproductionSteps: Launch the web app in Development with PlatformStubMode enabled.
confirmedIssues.observedBehavior: The default main shell swallowed the routed stub page content, preventing the intended stub-backed host from appearing.
confirmedIssues.expectedBehavior: The route should render the reusable stub alert plus the standalone Stub Platform shell without the main app shell wrapping it.

confirmedIssues.title: Skip link escaped the stub route when activated on a nested page
reproductionSteps: Tab to the Skip to main content link.
confirmedIssues.observedBehavior: The fragment-only href resolved against the app base path and navigated away from the nested stub route.
confirmedIssues.expectedBehavior: Activating the skip link should keep the current route and move focus into the stub workspace.

confirmedIssues.title: Stub customer search crashed when the hosted query page opened
reproductionSteps: Select Customers from the stub navigation.
confirmedIssues.observedBehavior: The Blazor circuit terminated because MudBlazor PropertyColumn received Func delegates instead of the required expression trees.
confirmedIssues.expectedBehavior: The hosted query page should open and render labeled filters plus the stub customer grid without a circuit failure.

confirmedIssues.title: Stub report navigation item was defined but not exposed in the shared navigation panel
reproductionSteps: Review the visible navigation options before any remediation.
confirmedIssues.observedBehavior: The stub shell received a report item, but the navigation panel did not render it when the top menu bar was absent, blocking the report-navigation checks.
confirmedIssues.expectedBehavior: The shared side navigation should surface the stub report item so the report tab can be opened from the hosted stub shell.

acceptedDeferrals: Full-application functional validation remains reserved for the later full-app UAT set.
Business-logic, persistence, and API-truth validation remain out of scope for this stub-backed design and navigation pass.
Distributor-domain copy and sample-story changes remain owned by distributor-reframe.
Multi-organization security and representative end-to-end workflow proof remain owned by their later Phase 2 sets.
